text:
Ana (partnerships): Kicking off a joint run with EdgeWorks — goal: thermofingerprint + kernel tuning to map perf/W and 99th perc latency. Can we sync on test plan & data hand-off? :wave:
Matt (eng-runtime): +1. I can spawn the measuring harness. Need sample model & sequence-length dist. What's target throughput?
Orion (EdgeWorks): We have two SKUs: EW-100 (16GB) and EW-200 (32GB). Can provide 3 racks next Tue. Throughput target we'd like to hit is ~1k tokens/s per board for short-chat workloads.
Sophie (observability): We'll collect per-token energy, GPU power, and kernel-id traces. Add this config to the run:
```
metrics:
  - p95_latency_ms
  - tokens_per_second
  - watts_avg
  - power_per_token
telemetry: kernel_id, sm_util, freq
```
Kyle (eng-ml): There's a kernel patch for reduced memcpy on EW-200. It'll change KV cache layout. Need to test patched vs unpatched. I'll push a PR by EOD.
Lia (eng-infra): For artifacts, use s3://redwood-interop/thermofingerprint/<run-id>/ and follow schema `run_meta.json` in /docs/interop/run-schema.md. We'll need partner VPN access — @Orion please confirm IP allowlist.
Orion (EdgeWorks): Confirmed. We'll add 52.48.12.0/24 to allowlist. Also shipping a power probe; is CSV ok? sample columns: timestamp,power_w,gpu_temp.
Ana (partnerships): Good. Quick experiment matrix: EW-100 / EW-200 x patched / unpatched x model-small / model-medium x offload-on / offload-off. Keep each sweep to 4 hours max.
Matt (eng-runtime): I'll template the matrix and create harness jobs. Example run command:
```
./run_workload.sh --hw EW-200 --model small --patch yes --out s3://redwood-interop/thermofingerprint/3781122334/
```
BenchBot: Job 3781122334-01 queued by Matt. ETA ~6h.
Sophie (observability): Reminder: include kernel-id mapping file in run_meta.json or we lose attribution across merges.
Ana (partnerships): Can we schedule a quick sync Fri 10am PT? Need a short marketing checklist for a joint note if results look good.
Orion (EdgeWorks): Fri 10am PT works for us — we'll bring thermal logs and probe calibration notes.
Kyle (eng-ml): I'll prepare an initial perf/W notebook after dry-run, aiming to highlight %gain on EW-200 with the kernel patch.
Lia (eng-infra): Created s3 prefix and fine-grained policy, invited orion@edgeworks.com to the bucket.
Ana (partnerships): Great — thanks everyone. I'll send calendar invite + prep checklist (data schema, secrecy checklist, embargo dates). :rocket:
